Type.evidence_source: The first account is of Ryan who took his own life at the age of 18 shortly after starting university. Ryan was described as an extremely high achiever in all aspects. However, these accounts reveal that Ryan suffered acute anxiety around his academic performance, personal achievement, and appearance, which manifested itself in a number of physical and psychological symptoms. His parents explained how the onset of his problems began when he started studying hard for examinations around the age of 16 (called exams in the extract below).
